    # Near-limit inputs (expected values from a reference solution; see test_audit/)
    def _big(seed, scale=1.0):
        import random
        rng = random.Random(seed)
        n = max(50, int(200000 * scale * scale))
        letters = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'
        s = [rng.choice(letters) for _ in range(n)]
        t = list(s)
        edits = 18 if seed % 2 else 26
        for _ in range(edits):
            op = rng.randrange(3)
            p = rng.randrange(len(t))
            if op == 0:
                t.insert(p, rng.choice(letters))
            elif op == 1:
                del t[p]
            else:
                t[p] = rng.choice([c for c in letters if c != t[p]])
        return (20, ''.join(s), ''.join(t))
    assert candidate(*_big(1)) == True
    assert candidate(*_big(2)) == False
